items.evidence: README command (play <runs>/medium-engine-3/work --ticks 400 --inputs 0:enter,10:up,40:shoot --seed 1 --settings DIR) printed one JSON line with all brief keys; --ticks 0 gives tick 0, screen title, texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit].
Same command with --frame f.png --size 800x480 wrote 'PNG image data, 800 x 480, RGBA' (title, settings, play, lost frames).
Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; 1:down,3:enter -> screen settings; 1:enter -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5.
From 8: one left -> 7; ten lefts -> 0 (not below); five rights -> 10 (not above).

Settings after Language right: texts [Defiende la puerta, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir, Ajustes, Volumen: 5, Idioma: Espanol, Volver]; next runs: title Spanish, play [Puntos: 10, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5], pause/lost Spanish too.
Run 1 set volume 5, es in folder s_keep (settings.json written there); run 2 with s_keep started at title with es, 5; new folder s_fresh started en, 8.
Up held 15 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 7.5; down 10 ticks: 6 -> 5; up held 300 ticks -> 12, down held 300 ticks -> 0 (clamped at field edges).
Shoot held from tick 35: 1 bolt at tick 36..59, 2nd appears tick 60, 3rd tick 84 (24 ticks); bolt advances 0.233/tick (14/s); single bolt x 19.941 at tick 112, gone at 113.
No input, tick 500: exactly 5 walkers at x 7.525..16.525 spaced 2.25 (90 ticks at 1.5/s), lanes 4,10,6,2,6; first walker x=10 at play tick 400 (1.5 u/s).

Guard y=4, one shot: tick 95 bolt 17.145 vs walker 17.65 health 2; tick 100 walker health 1, bolts []. Second shot: walker gone, score 10. Guard y=5 (1 unit off lane): bolt passed, walker health stays 2.
Tick 800 walker x 0.025, gate 5; tick 801 walker gone, gate 4. Run to 9000: screen lost, gate 0, texts [.., You lost, Score: 10, Enter: title].
Wave 1 last walker gone at tick 1161; wave 2 at 1341 (180 ticks), first walker 1342; 7 walkers at tick 1890 and 2050 (no 8th); texts 'Wave 2 of 5'.
Judge's own follow-mode bot (judge-scratch/jbot.py) seed 1: tick 5180 screen won, score 450, gate 5, texts [You won, Score: 450, Enter: title]; enter -> screen title.
Escape at 50: state at tick 100 and 400 identical (paused). Resume (enter at 200): walkers at 260 equal a no-pause run at 110. Down+enter in pause -> title.
Two runs seed 7, 700 ticks, same script: byte-identical output. Seeds 1/2/3 put wave 1 in lanes 4,10,6,2,6 / 10,10,6,10,8 / 2,4,6,4,2; no --seed equals seed 1.

Play frames do not show what the state says: tick 200 state 3 walkers, frame shows none; tick 400 state 5 walkers + 3 bolts, frame shows 1 walker, no bolts; tick 600 seed 3 shows 2 of 3 walkers, 1 of 3 bolts. Lanes y=6,8,10 never drawn. HUD (score, wave, gate), gate and guard are shown.
Title frame: name + Start/Settings/Quit with focus ring on Start; Spanish title frame with ring on Salir; settings frames (en, Volume focused; es, Idioma focused) in chosen language.
assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold all words; ui/*.json use @keys only; lib.rs has no shown words. README 'Adding a language' says copy en.json, set locale/name, translate.
README 'How to play' section and both commands (headless and --frame) ran as written (SETTINGS_FOLDER replaced by a folder name) with no engine running.

defects: Field shapes are all cubes at z=0, the same depth as the field background: in frames walkers, bolts and the upper lane lines vanish or show split (z-fighting), so the drawn field is unreliable.
On the settings screen, texts also lists the hidden title screen strings (Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit), which are not visible in the frame.
The Start button is always drawn in the blue 'primary' style, so on the title screen two buttons look highlighted when another entry is focused (the focus ring still marks the chosen one).
Guard may sit at y=0 or y=12, half off screen; bolts in flight stay in state and on screen after won/lost.
Spanish end screens say 'Enter: titulo' (key name left in English).
